name: Bezik baseline week (demo)
notes: Seven ordinary days with more barking than the demo days. offset_s is relative to the demo day's day_start: days -13..-7, i.e. 'last week' for the demo day (the previous 7-day period get_trend(days=7) compares against on the demo day, and the week the status card's 'barking vs last week' line averages). The good and bad day seeds write it automatically on load (baseline_seed); it can still be loaded on its own with the demo day's date.
